summary: Stonepeak-Plus Infrastructure Fund LP filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of limited partnership units in its continuous private offering. On August 3, 2026, the Fund sold 504,834 Class Z Series A-1a, 102,624 A-1c, 119,760 I-2, 266,425 M-I, 315,413 M-S, and 1,448 S-2 units for aggregate consideration of approximately $44.85 million, priced at July 31, 2026 Transactional NAV. Sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Watch for future NAV disclosures and offering updates.
